ValidationRule.description: This validation rule will require that a SIC Code be present or that the Sales SIC Description field be populated prior to a Working Capital Opportunity being put in Statements In.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'MCA_Oppty', ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Statements In - MCA'), ISBLANK(Statements_In_Date__c), ISBLANK(Account.SICCODE__c), ISBLANK(Account.SicDesc) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To fix this error, please input a description of the business' SIC on this customer's Account in the Sales SIC Description field.
